_comment: passwordChange is the only grant control here on purpose. Pairing it with mfa under an OR operator would let a user satisfy the policy with MFA alone, leaving the compromised credential in place and defeating the remediation. Entra requires multifactor authentication before a password change anyway. Requires Entra ID P2 licensing and password writeback enabled for hybrid users synced from SRV-DC01, since remediation writes the new password back on-premises. Deployed in report-only mode per Microsoft's guidance. Kept separate from the sign-in risk policy, which Microsoft explicitly recommends rather than combining both risk conditions in one policy. Legacy standalone Identity Protection risk policies retire October 1, 2026.
